options.label: Any% (Zipless)
options.rule: Beat the game without using zips as fast as possible.

options.label: True Ending (No Major Glitches)
options.rule:
Beat the game while getting the "true ending" without using major glitches.

The following are considered major glitches:
- Zips
- Rewind Tricks
- Menu Launch
- Load trigger / Story / Cutscene Manipulation
- Sonic Glitch
- Rewind Wallrun Extension
- Quicksand
- Drop Glitch
- Trap Fall-Damage Cancel
- Silhouette Clipping
- Ledge Storage
- Canceling a wallrun by pausing

Check [this guide](https://speedrun.com/pop_ww/guide/eeumn) for detailed explanation of each glitch.
